decision_scope: Bounded generated-art/native-compositing shot draft is usable for iteration. Not final S01-01 action, framing, sound or episode acceptance.

technical_evidence.video: ffprobe reports H264,1920x1080,24/1fps,144frames,6.000seconds. Full FFmpeg decode succeeds. No audio stream present.
technical_evidence.native: EffectCraft and FilmCraft JSON parse. PhotoCraft ZIP CRC passes; manifest retains background, paddle, foreground occluder, four ripple cels and BEFORE layers.
technical_evidence.inspection: Directly viewed sampled rendered frames; read timing/build script. Full decode is automated only. No real-time playback or audio listening claimed.
technical_evidence.motion: Samples show blade outside water, contact near frame24, increasing submersion through36/57, lift at75 and blade clear by93. Blade shape remains rigid; foreground water masks submerged section. This is an actual prop-motion compositing draft rather than a still camera pan.

positive_findings: Generated dark mangrove/water and wooden blade share a coherent painted/ink material treatment.
Rigid paddle and separate replacement ripple layers preserve editable action components.
BEFORE is correctly spelled, separately composited lower-left typography; no invented date.
Native masking visibly creates waterline submersion; frames and preview have correct six-second shot duration.

defects.evidence: Frame21 shows a broad faint ring beneath a blade whose tip is still above water. build_shot.py sets large-ring opacity with linear keys from0 at t0 to70 at2.75, so it fades in before the intended onset.
defects.repair: Gate large ring to zero until its intended onset with hold keys or a same-value key immediately before appearance; preserve its later fade separately.

defects.evidence: Frames include distant mangrove banks and broad water plane rather than a hand-width surface ECU. Blade/water event is foreground but environment reads as establishing view.
defects.repair: Reframe to a tighter near-water crop consistent with original shot, or explicitly seek staging change through normal author gate; do not silently call current framing exact script coverage.

defects.evidence: Four ring pictures replace one another, with the final large ellipse holding/fading in place. No visible falling lift droplets or detailed trailing water on exit.
defects.repair: Add registered expanding ripple breakdowns and falling droplets/contact response synchronized to lift. Keep broad ring center consistent with blade contact.

defects.evidence: Paddle stays a single rigid planar cel with limited rotation; waterline is a straight horizontal occlusion boundary. Physically plausible as a draft, but wet meniscus/reflection and nuanced blade-plane turn absent.
defects.repair: Refine local contact edge and planned blade turn with purpose-made cels if needed; preserve rigid wood geometry.

defects.evidence: Preview contains video only. Script requires drips/insects and interrupted frog call; no music.
defects.repair: Add separately reviewed original/licensed sound and sync contact/lift before final shot approval.

next_handoff: Fix pre-contact ring first; continue framing, water breakdowns and sound. Keep duration144frames and existing shot ID. No character-animation capability or complete episode inferred from this prop shot.
